description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate nursing leader to contribute to a high-quality care environment and make a significant impact on resident well-being.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the delivery of excellent patient care. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about geriatric care and committed to maintaining the highest standards of clinical practice and regulatory compliance. The compensation for this vital role ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 per year.If you are an RN with leadership aspirations and a desire to work in a supportive and dynamic setting, we encourage you to apply. Join a team that values your expertise and dedication to providing outstanding care.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license, highly preferred
Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility
Prior supervisory or leadership experience in a healthcare setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $60,000 - $75,000 per year, based on experience.
